name: 2 qt container of oil
description: 2 quarts of motor oil. Reduce 1 CP to gain Advantage on Mechanic skill rolls for repairing. Reduce 2 CP to deal 1d4 Resilience Fire Damage for 1d4 Combat Rounds.

name: 20L Jerry Can of Fuel
description: 20L (5 gallon) metal container of Fuel. Reduce 2 CP to deal 1d6 Fire-based Resilience Damage for 1d4 Combat Rounds, or Reduce 2 CP to give vehicles 1L of Fuel.

name: 25cm Taper Candle
description: Reduce 1 CP to produce 1 hour of Midrange light, or can cause 1 Resilience Damage. Can be extinguished and relit, but still loses 1 CP.

name: 9mm Auto
description: Concealable, Mag, Unreliable. Accepts 16 rounds.  Adds +10 to EAG.

name: Accumulator Flashlight
description: Fixed beam flashlight. Reduce 1 CP for 1 hour of Midrange light. Accumulator technology recharges 1 CP per hour of non-use via natural magnetism.

name: Acetaminophen
description: Reduce 2 CP to Increase Immunity Special Stat roll Degree of Success +1. Cannot reduce more than 8 CP at once.

name: Alarm Clock
description: Mechanical device that rapidly and repeatedly rings a small bell at the set time. Increases the EAG + 30.

name: Alcohol 80 Proof
description: Reduce 1 CP to gain 1 Food Unit and become STUNNED for 1 hour or reduce 1 CP to gain Advantage on a Medical skill roll. Or, Reduce 2 CP to cause 1d6 Fire-based Resilience Damage for 2 Combat Rounds.

name: Amphetamines
description: Reduce by 3 CP to gain +10 Initiative for 3 Combat Rounds. After 3 Combat Rounds, make a Resilience Special Stat roll against Knock-out (see page 68). Not cumulative with other Initiative bonuses.

name: Antidote
description: Created with the Medicine or Science skills. Reduce 2 CP to reduce 1 Stage of Infection.

name: Arrow
description: Ammunition for Bows and Crossbows. Receives Damage Code from the weapon.

name: Axe
description: Unbalanced, 2-Handed, Reach.

name: Backpack
description: Holds 100 CP off the body, allowing small items and most weapons to be carried. Does not hold rifles, bows, or sleeping bags, but these may be attached externally.

name: Ballistic Glasses
description: Tool used to gain +5 to Ballistic Skill Threshold.

name: Baseball Bat
description: Versatile.

name: Binoculars
description: Grants Advantage to Perception skill rolls over Long Distance, but Disadvantage to Perception skills from Midrange and below.

name: Bowstring Dampener
description: Reduce 1 CP to decrease the EAG from a bowstring -2 for 1 Attack Action.

name: Camo Tarp
description: Stealth skill rolls at ADVANTAGE when stationary (not moving).

name: Chain
description: Reach, Wrangling Skill.

name: Cigar (5)
description: Reduce by 2 CP to gain ADVANTAGE on Resolve rolls made within 5 hours of use or reduce by 2 CP to become an improvised delayed fuse that burns for 1 hour. EAG +5 when burning.

name: Cigarettes (10)
description: Reduce by 1 CP to gain ADVANTAGE on Resolve rolls made within 3 hours of use or reduce by 1 CP to become an improvised delayed fuse that burns for 10 Combat Rounds (1 Minute). EAG +2 when burning.

name: Club
description: Versatile.

name: Combat Knife
description: Balanced.

name: Comic Book
description: Resolve rolls are made at Advantage for 10 hours after reading. Reduce 1 CP to use as kindling to gain Advantage to Survival skill rolls when increasing Food Safe Levels (see Gamemaster Guide, page 19).

name: Compass
description: Grants Advantage to Navigation skill rolls.

name: Cord Saw
description: Grants Advantage to Survival skill rolls when Foraging. Can also be used to do Average (2d4) Damage or cut through wood, metal, bone, and ice.

name: Cosmetic Kit
description: Reduce 1 CP to gain Advantage on Charm skill rolls.

name: Crossbow
description: Uses Firearms Skill, requires 1 complex action to load. +1 EAG.

name: Crowbar
description: Grants Advantage on Prying actions. Can be used as a Heavy (H) Blunt Weapon.

name: Deck of Playing Cards
description: Grants Advantage to Palming rolls for "cheating."

name: Drone Command Unit
description: A book sized Radio Frequency GUI-operated Device that controls up to 3 drones within Midrange. With a Successful Tech Use skill roll, the device can be modified to send and receive voice transmissions, connect to the global information network used for Robot communication, or hack a Robot or Drone within Midrange. If connected to the Robot communication network, becomes infected with the Robot Sentience Code.

name: Duct Tape
description: Reduce by 1 CP to gain Advantage on Crafting, Mechanics, Medicine or Science skill rolls.

name: Edible Mushrooms
description: Reduce by 3 CP to gain 1 Food Unit. If mixed with 1 other Food Unit (water), it produces a 4 Food Unit soup.

name: Energy Drink
description: Reduce by 2 CP to provide +5 Initiative for 3 Combat Rounds. Not cumulative with other Initiative bonuses.

name: Ethanol Gel
description: Reduce by 1 CP to gain ADVANTAGE to Survival skill rolls when increasing Food Safe Levels (see Gamemaster Guide, page 19), or Reduce by 2 CP to cause 1d6 Fire-based Resilience Damage per Combat Round until extinguished by smothering with 2 Complex Actions. If mixed with water, increases to 2d6 Fire-based Resilience Damage per Combat Round.

name: Extra Clothes
description: Grants Advantage to the Charm skills.

name: Firearm Ammunition
description: Used for firearms. Ammunition costs 1 complex CP (4 CP) each and can be ANY damage code. Ammunition only works in a firearm with the corresponding Damage Code.

name: Flare
description: Ignites as a Complex Action and immediately increases the EAG +10. Provides Midrange light. Can be used to cause Heavy (H) Resilience Damage to a target and burns for 1d10+2 minutes. Cannot be extinguished.

name: Folding Knife
description: Concealable,Balanced.

name: Food Unit
description: 1 Unit of Food required to be eaten each day based on the character's Build stat. (see Hunger Damage, page 54)

name: Game Bag
description: Mesh bag that Holds 2 Food Units when full and can be used as a Lure when Hunting (does not get destroyed).

name: Geiger Counter
description: Reduce 1 CP to gain 1 hour of radiation scanning on objects, places or persons. Accumulator technology recharges 1 CP per hour of non-use.

name: Glow Stick
description: Single use. Provides 12 hours of Short Range light via chemiluminescence when "cracked." Cannot be extinguished. EAG +5.

name: Government ID
description: Grants Advantage on Charm skill rolls. A Great Success or better on a Perception skill roll reveals the ID to be expired or fake.

name: Ground Coffee
description: Reduce by 1 CP to gain 1 Food Unit. When mixed with 1 other Food Unit, this can be consumed by 1 character to gain +3 Initiative for 3 Combat Rounds within 6 hours. Not cumulative with other Initiative bonuses.

name: Handcuffs
description: Grants Advantage to Interrogate skill roll, and Grapple actions.

name: Handheld Shortwave Radio
description: A handheld device that can send and receive radio transmissions over Long Range.

name: Hatchet
description: Balanced, Versatile.

name: Hunting Boots
description: Grants Disadvantage to Athletic skill rolls, but negates the EAG increases from movement.

name: Isopropyl Alcohol (500mL)
description: Reduce by 1 CP to gain Advantage on Medicine skill rolls or Reduce by 2 CP to ignite with flame for 1d4 Fire-based Resilience Damage for 2 Combat Rounds.

name: Katana
description: Unbalanced, 2-Handed, Reach.

name: Laptop
description: A portable device with attached keyboard, screen, and graphic interface. Does not require a Tech Use skill for basic functions, but does for programming or connecting to the Robot communication network. Basic Use: "Record" data that can be used later to gain Advantage on Academics or Science skill rolls. Reduce 1 CP to use for 1 hour. After 4 CP have been removed, it must be recharged through external power supplies, like a Solar Charging Unit.

name: Large Net
description: Grants Advantage to Wrangle skill rolls or Hunting near water.

name: Lever Rifle
description: Multi-Attack, Unreliable. Accepts 6 rounds. +10 EAG.

name: Lighter
description: Reduce by 1 CP to cause 1 Fire-based Resilience Damage to a target or ignite flammable objects. Burns for 5 minutes before self-extinguishing but extinguishes if used to cause damage.

name: Lithium Ion Battery
description: Reduce by 1 CP to grant 1 hour of electrical energy (even to vehicles). After 4 CP have been removed, it must be recharged through external power supplies, like a Solar Charging Unit.

name: Magic Mushroom
description: Reduce by 3 CP to gain Advantage on Resolve Special Stat rolls for 5 hours due to ongoing hallucinations. After this same period, character gains Disadvantage on all Resilience Special Stat rolls until next sleep.

name: Matches (10)
description: Reduce by 1 CP to light as a Complex Action to gain Close Range light OR ignite flammable object. Extinguishes after 1 Action Phase.

name: Mechanically Powered Flashlight
description: Reduce 1 CP to gain 1 hour of filtered Midrange light that cannot be seen farther than Short Range. After 4 CP have been removed, it can be recharged with manual charging actions at a rate of 1-minute charging to regain 1 CP.

name: Medical Kit
description: Reduce 1 CP to increase the Treatment Code by 1 on a Medicine skill roll. Can be combined with other Medical Kits to replenish CP.

name: Military Pack
description: A special designed backpack that reduces the Success Requirement on a Quick-draw action to a Success (1 Degree) via several accessible pockets. Holds 100 CP off the body.

name: Military Survival Manual
description: Grants Advantage to survival skill rolls. Characters also decrease the cost for gaining or increasing the proficiency with the Survival skill by 100 XP.

name: Molotov Cocktail
description: Burns 1d6 rounds.  EAG +5

name: MRE (1)
description: "Meals Ready to Eat." Provides 3 Food Units in sealed, protective packaging.

name: Old Magazine
description: Grants Advantage to Resolve Special Stat rolls for 10 hours after reading. Reduce 1 CP to use as kindling to gain Advantage to Survival skill rolls when increasing Food Safe Levels (see Gamemaster Guide, page 19).

name: Old Road Atlas
description: Grants Advantage on Navigation skill rolls.

name: Oxygen Mask
description: 2 Armor Points that cannot be destroyed without a Called Shot action. Grants Advantage on Immunity Special Stat rolls. Can be combined with an Oxygen Tank to ignore Immunity Rolls.

name: Oxygen Tank
description: 5 Armor Point objects that contains 8 CP of air. Cannot be destroyed without a Called Shot action, but if destroyed while containing at least 1 CP of air, it explodes for Heavy (H) Damage within Close Range. Reduce 1 CP to gain 1 hour of pressurized air that can be breathed or sprayed. Once it has been reduced by 8 CP, the air must be recharged with a Crafting skill roll at a rate of 1 CP per Degree of Success. Can be repeated multiple times at 1 hour each.

name: Pencil and Paper
description: Grants Advantage to Academic Skill rolls or any skill the character has previously recorded using 2 Complex Actions.

name: Personalized Grip
description: Tool used to grant +5 to Fighting Skill Thresholds.

name: Plastic Canteen (1 Liter)
description: Holds 2 Food Unit when full or holds 6 CP of other liquids.

name: Potassium Iodide
description: Reduce by 2 CP to decrease Immunity Success Requirement against Radiation by 1. Cannot reduce more than 8 CP at once.

name: Pouch
description: Carries 20 CP off the body. This can be 10 arrows or 5 rounds of ammunition.

name: Psychedelic pills
description: Reduce by 2 CP to gain ADVANTAGE on Resolve Special Stat rolls for 5 hours due to ongoing hallucinations. During this same period, character gains DISADVANTAGE on all Resilience Special Stat rolls. After this period, the character becomes UNNERVED until their next Sleep. Requires a Great Success or better on a Medicine or Science skill roll to create.

name: Quickdraw Holster
description: Reduces the Success Requirement on a Quick-draw action to a Success (1 Degree).

name: Radiation Suit
description: 1 Armor Point object. Reduces Immunity Success Requirements by 2.

name: Rain Poncho
description: Grants Advantage on Resilience Special Stat rolls against Weather.

name: Raw chemicals
description: Stable chemicals that can be used as CP for Science skill rolls. Reduce by 4 CP to make explosives, ammunition, etc.

name: Recurve Bow
description: Strength required 20, DC Mod Max +1. +2 EAG.

name: Reinforced Bowstring
description: Attached to a bow, this grants +5 to the Archery skill Threshold.

name: Religious Holy Book
description: Grants Advantage to Resolve Special Stat rolls when held. As a side effect, it causes Disadvantage on Xenotech Use skill rolls when held.

name: Repair Kit
description: Reduce 1 CP to increase the Repair Code by 1 on a Crafting, Mechanics, or Science skill roll. Can be combined with other Repair Kits to replenish CP.

name: Rope (30m)
description: Grants Advantage to Athletic rolls when climbing. Can be made into a lasso to catch animals or people with the Wrangle skill.

name: Rubber Mallet
description: Increase Success Requirement +1 to negate the EAG increase when using a Crafting, Mechanics, and Science skill.

name: Running Shoes
description: Grants Advantage to Athletics skill rolls, but Disadvantage to Stealth skill rolls.

name: Sci-Fi novel
description: Grants Advantage to Resolve Special Stat rolls for 10 hours after reading. Reduce 1 CP to use as kindling to gain Advantage to Survival skill rolls when increasing Food Safe Levels (see Gamemaster Guide, page 19).

name: Silencer (Firearm)
description: Reduce by 1 CP to reduce EAG increase -5 per use.

name: Sleeping Bag
description: Grants Advantage on Resilience Special Stat rolls against Weather during Rests or Sleeps.

name: Soap
description: Reduce 1 CP to gain Advantage on Charm skill rolls for 12 hours.

name: Solar Charging Unit
description: Recharges a battery 1 CP every 1 hour during the day.

name: Spray Paint
description: Reduce by 1 CP to gain Advantage on Crafting skill rolls for leaving legible messages or symbols, or Reduce by 2 CP and combine with Lighter, match, or Flare to cause 1d4 Fire-based Resilience Damage to 1 Target within Short Range.

name: Sunglasses
description: Grants Advantage to Perception skill rolls in conditions that would grant Disadvantage due to brightness or reflections. However, grants Disadvantage to Perception Skill rolls in dim light.

name: Tea
description: Reduce by 1 CP to gain 1 Food Unit. When mixed with 1 other Food Unit, this can be consumed by 1 character to gain +2 Initiative for 2 Combat Rounds within 6 hours. Not cumulative with other Initiative bonuses.

name: Tent (Pup)
description: Can house 300 BUILD worth of characters. Ignores Resilience rolls against Weather during Rests or Sleeps.

name: Throwing Knife
description: Concealable, Balanced.

name: Toilet Paper
description: Reduce by 1 CP to gain Advantage on Charm skill rolls.

name: Toolbelt
description: Holds 2 sets of tools at the waist (Ignores tools for CP).

name: Tools
description: Set of items used on related skill actions (i.e. hammers, picks). Some may be considered as weapons; the Gamemaster must determine if they are. Chemistry set: Science skill. Climbing tools: Athletics skill. Cartographer tools: Navigation skill. Crafting tools: Crafting skill. Dog Whistle: Animal Ken skill. Entrenching tools: Survival skill. Fishing Rod: Tracking skill. Flint and Steel: Survival skill. Lockpick tools: Lockpick skill. Mechanics tools: Mechanics skill. Surgical tools: Medicine skill. Thumb drive: Tech Use skill. Torture tools: Interrogate skill.

name: Toothbrush
description: Grants Advantage to Charm skill rolls for 5 hours after use.

name: Watch
description: Made of several pieces, it reduces 1 CP every year. Possesses an "alarm" function that increases the EAG +10.

name: Water Bottle
description: Holds 1 Food Unit when full or 3 CP of other liquids.

name: Water Filter
description: Reduce by 4 CP to gain Advantage to Survival skill rolls when increasing Food Safe Levels. Automatically increases Water Safe Level +20 before the roll (see Gamemaster Guide, page 19).

name: Well-Kept Gold Jewelry
description: Grants ADVANTAGE to Charm skills rolls.

name: Wire (10m)
description: Reduce 1 CP to gain Advantage on Crafting or Mechanics skill rolls, or reduce 1 CP to create a "trip wire" with a 20% "trip chance." For every 1 additional CP added, the trip chance increased +5%. The wire can be attached to an explosive or improvised 1d6 damage trap.

name: Wool Socks
description: Grants Advantage to Resilience Special Stat rolls, but Disadvantage to Athletics skill rolls.

name: Z-virus Antiserum
description: Grants Advantage on Immunity Special Stat rolls against the Z-Virus. Requires a Great Success or better on a Science skill roll to create. The experimental Z-virus Anti-Serum is highly volatile and breaks down within several hours. If not used before the end of the game day, it is no longer viable and the CP are lost.

name: .38 Revolver
description: Concealable, Reliable. Accepts 5 rounds.  Adds +7 to EAG.

name: .44 Revolver
description: Reliable. Requires Strength 40. Accepts 6 rounds.  Adds +15 to EAG.

name: .45 Auto
description: Mag, Multi-Attack. Requires Strength 25. Accepts 13 rounds.  Adds +15 to EAG.

name: .357 Revolver
description: Concealable, Reliable. Accepts 6 rounds.  Adds +10 to EAG.
